messages:
noah: quick check: onboarding pulse-13b int4v3 shows reproducible tail divergence after a resume from pause+checkpoint. happens when prefill > 10k and resume occurs during a background flush. anyone seen resume-specific RoPE jumps?
mei: what exact resume flow? is this from operator pause or autosave resume? also post the minimal prompt
noah: autosave resume. repro cmd: `./onboard/run_resume.sh --model pulse-13b --quant int4v3 --prompt samples/long_archive.txt --seed 5 --autosave 9s` logs: ```
[2026-03-20T23:05:12Z] prefill=11264 flush_inflight=256 autosave=1
[2026-03-20T23:05:12Z] KV_COMMIT idx=11263 expected=11264
[2026-03-20T23:05:12Z] resume: rot_phase=0.999995 -> 0.999872
[2026-03-20T23:05:13Z] tail_hash mismatch 0x1a2b -> 0x3c4d
```
ralph: that rot_phase delta is big enough to flip argmax for some contexts. does `REDWOOD_KV_CACHE=0` change anything?
noah: with cache off kv warnings disappear but rot_phase flip persists. reproducible on dedicated and hosted.
mei: try `ROPE_SYNC_ON_RESUME=1` which snaps local phase counters to master at resume. also run `--dump-kv-snapshot` on both sides to compare.
ralph: also compare kernel fp-mode: fusion kernels may use fp16 accumulators. `USE_STRICT_FP=1` test might help.
qa-bot: created gating-ticket ONB-4201: "pulse-13b resume rot_phase jump + kv off-by on autosave" https://redwood/onboard/ONB-4201
triage-bot: linked infra issue INFRA-3244 for checkpoint atomicity check
noah: assigning to @mei @ralph. I'll attach minimal prompt + seed sweeps and the dump. please add a smoke eval to onboarding: pause/resume mid-prefill and assert tail_hash invariance across 3 resumes.
mei: will add to onboarding harness and try `ROPE_SYNC_ON_RESUME=1` patch locally. if that fixes it's a good mitigation.
ralph: if we can't stabilize, block promote until root cause is found. thanks all.
